sources.title: Swift app project
sources.finding: XcodeGen project for the native SwiftUI app with iOS 26.0 and macOS 26.0 deployment targets.

sources.title: Executor architecture
sources.locator: Resource control; Gateway settings table; Failure behavior
sources.finding: Detached run hosts in transient systemd units with admission checks (active count 128, MemAvailable, CPU PSI 85), cgroup slices with CPU weights, bounded backoff and visible timeout, failure table.

sources.title: Goals
sources.finding: Self-pacing goals with a 5-minute wake floor and optional maxWakes.

sources.title: Webhook automation concurrency tests
sources.finding: Webhook automations default to one run at a time and allow overlap up to a configured cap.

sources.title: Repo lifecycle
sources.finding: Repositories commit .agents/setup and .agents/portals.json so workspaces provision themselves and expose apps as Portals.

sources.title: Frontend typing and presence
sources.finding: Web client tracks who is typing and viewing a session.

sources.title: Audit log
sources.finding: One JSON line per event into a daily file under ~/.opensession-audit; an external agent can ship the files.

sources.title: AI review guide
sources.finding: Story-first PR guide split into sections, saved per PR keyed by per-file diff hashes, updated on push.

sources.title: Review requests
sources.finding: Reviewer picker flags a session into the reviewer's Needs review band with a push alert until cleared.

sources.title: PR merge readiness
sources.finding: Deterministic read-only merge verdict from live GitHub state, checks, review decision and rulesets.

sources.title: Stacked PRs
sources.finding: Reads GitHub stacked pull request chains (public preview) through GraphQL.

sources.title: Commit to session lookup
sources.finding: Finds the session that shipped a commit from the transcript.

sources.title: Session builds and rollouts
sources.finding: Shows CI workflow runs, jobs and continuous-delivery status for a session from GitHub webhooks.

sources.title: Deploys
sources.finding: Durable agent-published internal web apps as immutable version snapshots behind the same sign-in gate.
